newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Elite rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Elite rated a buy.

text.p: Israel's Elite Industries Ltd was rated a buy in a report issued on Sunday by the Israeli brokerage Ofek Securities and Investments.
Analyst Ephraim Steinbrook said Elite, a maker of food products, principally coffee and chocolates, had cut its loss-making activities in Europe and was implementing structural changes at home.
He said the changes should create the conditions for Elite to form a strategic partnership with a multinational company as many other leading Israeli food companies have done over the last two years.

"Despite increased competition and the erosion of Israeli food manufacturers' profits, Elite is likely to improve its results and profitability in the coming years as a result of the reorganisation in the group's structure," Steinbrook said in the report.

He estimated net earnings would reach 39 million shekels in 1996, turning around from a 6.6 million shekel loss the previous year. He forecast net earnings would to rise to 53 million shekels in 1997 and 59 million shekels in 1998.
